problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2 \\ -4\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -15 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$

activity_context.topic_title: Expressing the Coordinates of a Vector in a Given Basis

feedback.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3 \\ 6 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0 \\ 10 \\ 10\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ -5 \\ 16 \\ 10\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$,  ${x}_{2}$, and ${x}_{3}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3 \\ 6 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0 \\ 10 \\ 10\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}10 \\ -5 \\ 16 \\ 10\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

From this, we get the system with the augmented matrix $M$, which we reduce using Gaussian elimination: 

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & 0 & 10 \\ -3 & 0 & 0 & -5 \\ 6 & 10 & -2 & 16 \\ 0 & 10 & 0 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+{R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & 0 & 10 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 5 \\ 6 & 10 & -2 & 16 \\ 0 & 10 & 0 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & 0 & 10 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 10 & 0 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-2){R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & 0 & 10 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

   

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=10 \\ 5{x}_{2}=5 \\ -2{x}_{3}=-4 \\ 0=0,\end{aligned}
$$

From the fourth equation, we get a true statement. Then, from the second and third equation, we get ${x}_{2}=1$ and  ${x}_{3}=2$ respectively. Substituting ${x}_{2}=1$ into the first equation, we get 

$$
3{x}_{1}+5(1)=10\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=\frac{5}{3}.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{3} \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$ 

Finally, ${x}_{1}=\frac{5}{3}.$
